ten_qualified_exposures.reason: Marketplace impressions do not verify that viewers currently hold multiple agency proposals; qualified access otherwise requires recruitment or partnerships.

next_test.single_uncertainty: Can one low-touch channel deliver ten people currently comparing at least two agency proposals?
next_test.continue_signal: A named channel, qualification method, bounded cost, and bounded Anton workload are established before launch.
next_test.stop_signal: Access requires recurring manual recruitment, professional partnerships, or paid acquisition with no bounded CAC.
next_test.insufficient_signal: Fewer than ten verified qualified exposures.
